headline: Google's Gemini 'Call for Me' Rolls Out on Pixel 11
summary: Google began a preliminary rollout of 'Call for Me,' a Gemini feature exclusive to select Pixel 11 subscribers that makes phone calls via AI chatbot, according to Engadget and Wired.

claims.statement: Google's 'Call for Me' Gemini feature is rolling out for Pixel 11 users.

sources.quote: Pixel 11's Call For Me feature begins preliminary rollout
Google’s Gemini Can Now Make Calls for You on Pixel Phones

claims.statement: The feature is exclusive to select Gemini subscribers with a Pixel 11.

sources.quote: Select Gemini subscribers with a Pixel 11 can soon try out phone calls via AI chatbot.
a feature that’s exclusive to the Pixel 11 series
